description: The Regulation uses affected persons (Art. 2(1)(g), Art. 26, Art. 27, Art. 85-86) but Article 3 contains no definition of the term; the category is taken as printed.
treatment: Recorded as a type-level position with no multiplicity; no further delimitation inferred.
effect_on_claims: Any relation or assignment naming affected persons rests on the printed term only.

description: The clause is a non-preclusion (savings) formulation also naming the Union; it is not clear that it constitutes a competence rather than recalling retained competence; the Union is named without a Union position being specified.
treatment: Coded as a permission with norm type N0 on the Member State position; the Union is not coded as a position.
effect_on_claims: Function recorded as FUNCTION_VOCABULARY_UNRESOLVED (GAP-05) because no documented function category fits a savings clause.

description: The AI Office is defined as a Commission function provided for in a Commission Decision outside W; the Regulation states that references to the AI Office are references to the Commission.
treatment: All AI Office references are coded to the Commission position; the AI Office is not coded as a separate position or device.
effect_on_claims: Claims about internal organisation or separate legal personality of the AI Office are undetermined; claims about the Commission as holder of the tasks are unaffected.

description: Article 5(1) points (a) to (g) prohibit practices (placing on the market, putting into service or use) without naming a norm addressee; the text does not say which operator position is bound for each of the three acts.
treatment: The prohibition is recorded as a constraint on the operator category (Article 3(8)); no split between provider (placing on the market, putting into service) and deployer (use) is asserted, and no counterparty is invented.
effect_on_claims: Any statement about which operator position bears a prohibition rests on this category-level reading.

description: Point (h) names no addressee; the law enforcement authority is derived from the definitions of law enforcement and law enforcement authority.
treatment: Derived assignment on the law enforcement authority, derivation stated.
effect_on_claims: Persons acting on behalf of law enforcement authorities are covered by the definition of law enforcement but are not a separate position.

description: The party requesting and using the authorisation is not named in Article 5(3); it is identified only by cross-reference to Article 5(2) second subparagraph.
treatment: Relation coded with the law enforcement authority as counterpart, marked derived, with the derivation stated.
effect_on_claims: If the user were another body, the counterpart would change.

description: Article 6(7) uses shall adopt (obligation) in the same delegated-act context as Article 6(6) is empowered to adopt (competence); the norm type is compound or ambiguous.
treatment: Recorded as N3 with the obligation wording noted.
effect_on_claims: Whether a duty to act exists on the stated evidence is not settled.

description: The permission to process special categories of personal data is expressed as may exceptionally process, subject to safeguards and to conditions that all must be met in order for such processing to occur: a permission (N3) with a condition on legal effect (N4).
treatment: Recorded as COMPOUND; the permission is recorded as available only when the stated conditions are met.
effect_on_claims: Whether the permission arises before the conditions are met is not settled.

description: Article 14(4) states that the high-risk AI system shall be provided to the deployer so that natural persons are enabled to oversee it, without naming the party that provides the system; the provider is named in Article 14(3)(b) for the identification of measures.
treatment: The relation is coded provider -> deployer, with the provision step attributed to the provider on the basis of Article 14(3) and Article 3(3) (the provider places the system on the market or puts it into service).
effect_on_claims: If the provision step lay with another operator, the origin would change.

description: The cooperation partners are described only as relevant stakeholders and organisations such as metrology and benchmarking authorities; no legally specified position or delimitation is given.
treatment: Recorded as a type-level category with no multiplicity; used as counterpart of a cooperation relation.
effect_on_claims: The relation rests on a loosely defined category and would not support any claim about identifiable institutions.

description: Articles 21 to 24 use competent authority and relevant competent authorities, while Article 3(48) defines only national competent authority (notifying authority or market surveillance authority). The relation between the two terms is not defined in the instrument.
treatment: Coded as a separate type-level position distinct from the national competent authority position; no inclusion relation asserted.
effect_on_claims: Relations naming competent authority cannot be merged with relations naming national competent authority or market surveillance authority without a reading.

description: The content of the accessibility requirements rests on external Directives not retrieved.
treatment: Duty recorded with the reference; content not analysed.
effect_on_claims: Any claim on what the accessibility duty requires is undetermined.

description: The deeming and documentation-integration rules for financial institutions refer to unspecified Union financial services law outside W.
treatment: Obligations recorded with the reference; the external content not analysed.
effect_on_claims: Claims about what financial-institution providers must do are undetermined beyond the printed rule.

description: Duties to demonstrate conformity or provide documentation on reasoned request create a duty to explain/justify to an identified authority with a questioning capacity (the request), but the provisions state no institutionalized assessment or judgment capacity and no grounded consequence.
treatment: Classified ANSWERABILITY with answerability_only noted and sufficiency indeterminate; no accountability asserted.
effect_on_claims: Whether the supervision/enforcement provisions of Chapter IX supply assessment and consequences, so that these relations become accountability relations, is not asserted.

description: The documents are also kept at the disposal of national authorities or bodies referred to in Article 74(10); that cross-reference is resolved within W where Article 74 is coded and is not added as an additional party here.
treatment: Only the competent authority is coded as counterpart; the additional bodies are recorded in the conditions.
effect_on_claims: The relation may have further parties once Article 74(10) is resolved.

description: The distributor must ensure corrective action by the provider, the importer or any relevant operator; the text gives the distributor no stated power over those operators.
treatment: Coded as an oversight_supervision relation with direction as stated (distributor ensures); no authority attribute is inferred.
effect_on_claims: The relation records a duty of result, not a legal power of the distributor over the other operators.

description: The written-agreement duty binds both the provider and the third party; the origin/counterpart assignment is a recording convention.
treatment: Origin = provider, counterpart = third-party supplier, no governance direction asserted.
effect_on_claims: Direction of governance work is not asserted.

description: Article 26(10) names a judicial authority or an administrative authority whose decision is binding and subject to judicial review, whereas Article 5(3) names a judicial authority or an independent administrative authority whose decision is binding; the two descriptions are not stated to be the same category.
treatment: Recorded as two separate type-level positions; no identity asserted.
effect_on_claims: Relations of the two authorisation regimes cannot be pooled without a reading.

description: Article 27(2) combines a permission (may rely on previous assessments) with obligations (applies to first use; shall update).
treatment: Recorded as COMPOUND on the deployer position.
effect_on_claims: The status of each element is recorded together.

description: The accreditation certificate is mentioned as accompanying the application; the provision does not state a duty or power of the national accreditation body to issue it.
treatment: Coded as a declaratory verification relation from the accreditation body to the conformity assessment body; no duty or power is asserted.
effect_on_claims: The relation records only that a certificate may exist; its content and effect are those of the referenced Regulation.

description: The authority responsible for notified bodies is not defined; it is read as the notifying authority on the basis of Article 3(19) and Article 28(1).
treatment: Counterpart coded as the notifying authority with the derivation stated.
effect_on_claims: If another authority is meant the counterpart changes.

description: The addressee of an objection is not named; the notifying authority making the notification is taken as counterpart, and the origin is the Commission with the other Member States as additional parties.
treatment: Relation coded with the derivation stated; direction not otherwise asserted.
effect_on_claims: If objections were addressed to another party the counterpart would change.

description: Article 31(1) says a notified body shall be established under national law and have legal personality; it is not clear whether this establishes the body (N1), requires establishment (N2) or sets a condition on a body created elsewhere.
treatment: Recorded as N0 on the notified body position; no entity is treated as constituted by the Regulation.
effect_on_claims: Legal constitution of notified bodies by the Regulation is not asserted.

description: The sectoral group of notified bodies is described as the form in which coordination and cooperation between notified bodies is put in place and properly operated; it has an identifiable function and a Commission duty to ensure it, but no named operator or rules in Article 38.
treatment: Recorded as a type-level institutional forum (position), not a device, because it is a group of identifiable parties (the notified bodies) rather than a tool or instrument.
effect_on_claims: If the group were treated as a device the party structure of the coordination relations would change.

description: The authorising party and the Union agreements are not named in Article 39.
treatment: Permission recorded as an assignment without counterparty; the agreements are recorded as an external reference with constitutive dependency.
effect_on_claims: Claims on third-country conformity assessment bodies acting as notified bodies are undetermined.

description: The committee is established under Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, outside W.
treatment: Recorded as a type-level position referenced by the Regulation; no instance is created and the committee constitution is not analysed.
effect_on_claims: Claims on the committee composition or powers are undetermined.

description: The duty to duly justify names no recipient or forum.
treatment: Recorded as a normative assignment without counterparty; no counterparty is invented.
effect_on_claims: No relation can be coded for the justification duty.

description: Article 43(1) combines a choice between two procedures (permission) with a mandatory Annex VII procedure in listed circumstances (conditional obligation).
treatment: Recorded as COMPOUND on the provider position.
effect_on_claims: The status of each element is recorded together.

description: Article 50 refers to natural persons concerned and exposed without relating them to the affected persons of Article 2(1)(g).
treatment: Recorded as a separate type-level position; no identity with affected persons asserted.
effect_on_claims: Relations of Article 50 cannot be merged with relations naming affected persons without a reading.

description: Article 44(3) second subparagraph states that an appeal procedure against decisions of notified bodies shall be available, without naming the obligor, the forum or the appellant.
treatment: No relation is coded for the appeal procedure; the statement is recorded without derived records.
effect_on_claims: Review of notified body decisions cannot be represented as a relation from this text.

description: The request on which a market surveillance authority may authorise the derogation is described only as duly justified; the requesting party is not named.
treatment: Recorded as an assignment without counterparty; no counterparty is invented.
effect_on_claims: No relation to the requester can be coded for paragraph 1.

description: Article 51(3) uses shall adopt delegated acts in a context of when necessary, a duty framing of a delegated-act competence.
treatment: Recorded as N3 with the obligation wording noted.
effect_on_claims: Whether a duty to act exists when the necessity condition is met is not settled.

description: The Commission shall take the request into account and may decide to reassess: a duty of consideration combined with a discretionary competence.
treatment: Recorded as a competence (modality competence) with the duty to take the request into account in the action field.
effect_on_claims: Whether the duty applies independently of the decision to reassess is not settled.

description: The content of the copyright policy duty depends on Union copyright law and Directive (EU) 2019/790, not retrieved.
treatment: Duty recorded with the reference; external content not analysed.
effect_on_claims: What the policy must contain is undetermined.

description: Participants report regularly on implementation and the AI Office and the Board monitor, evaluate and assess adequacy, but the provisions state no consequence and the reporting duty is framed as an aim of the AI Office.
treatment: Classified ANSWERABILITY with sufficiency indeterminate; no accountability asserted.
effect_on_claims: Whether reporting plus monitoring and the Commission power to approve or replace codes form an accountability relation is not asserted.

description: The prohibition on imposing fines names the authorities without specifying which; the competent authority is used as the bearer.
treatment: Recorded as a constraint on the competent authority position.
effect_on_claims: Whether market surveillance authorities and the Commission are also bound is not stated.

description: The sandbox personal-data permission is a may be processed when all of the following conditions are met formulation (permission with conditions on legal effect); the processing party is not named in the chapeau.
treatment: Recorded as COMPOUND on the provider position, derived from points (d) and (e) naming prospective providers and providers.
effect_on_claims: Whether the permission arises before the conditions are met, and which party holds it, is not settled.

description: Real-world testing is expressed as may be conducted ... only where all of the following conditions are met: a permission with conditions on legal effect.
treatment: Recorded as COMPOUND on the provider position.
effect_on_claims: Whether the permission arises before the conditions are met is not settled.

description: The party that sets the conformity assessment fees and takes SME interests into account is not named.
treatment: No assignment or relation is coded for Article 62(2); the statement is recorded without derived records.
effect_on_claims: The fee-reduction rule cannot be attributed to a position from the text.

description: The two standing sub-groups of the Board are fora with an identifiable function, within the Board; the market surveillance sub-group is stated to act as the administrative cooperation group within the meaning of Article 30 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
treatment: Recorded as type-level institutional fora (positions), not devices; the sub-groups are to be established by the Board (obligation), so no instance is created and their constitution is not asserted.
effect_on_claims: Whether the sub-group acting as the administrative cooperation group is the same institution as the one in the referenced Regulation is not settled.

description: Article 67(1) says an advisory forum shall be established without naming who establishes it and without a direct-effect formula such as is hereby established used for the Board in Article 65(1).
treatment: Recorded with norm type AMBIGUOUS; legal constitution of the forum as an entity is recorded as obligation only.
effect_on_claims: Whether the Regulation itself constitutes the forum (N1) or obliges an unnamed party to establish it (N2) is not settled.

description: The authority must indicate the grounds of its decision or objection and how the provider can challenge it; the challenge forum and review procedure are not named.
treatment: Classified INFO only (statement of reasons and challenge route); no accountability asserted because no forum, assessment capacity or consequence is identified in the provision.
effect_on_claims: Review of decisions of market surveillance authorities cannot be represented as a relation from this text.

description: Article 77(1) does not name the party that holds or provides the documentation.
treatment: Recorded as an assignment without counterparty.
effect_on_claims: No relation to documentation holders is coded.

description: The right to obtain an explanation creates a duty of the deployer to explain a decision to the person affected, with a questioning capacity of that person, but the provision states no assessment or judgment capacity and no consequence.
treatment: Classified ANSWERABILITY with sufficiency indeterminate; no accountability asserted.
effect_on_claims: Whether the right to explanation together with complaint and remedy provisions forms an accountability relation is not asserted.

description: Article 89(2) states the downstream provider right to lodge a complaint without naming the addressee; Section 5 attributes the supervision powers to the Commission through the AI Office, but the paragraph does not say that the complaint is addressed to it.
treatment: Recorded as an assignment (entitlement) without counterparty; no relation is coded.
effect_on_claims: A complaint relation to the Commission would be an inference from the Section context.

description: The duties of providers of general-purpose AI models to supply information and access to the Commission combine a duty to explain, a questioning capacity (requests), an assessment capacity (assessing compliance, evaluations) and fines referred to in Article 101; whether these elements are combined into an accountability relation across provisions is not asserted here.
treatment: Classified ACCOUNTABILITY (derived across Articles 91, 92 and 101) with sufficiency indeterminate because an explicit duty to explain or justify is not stated; the duty to demonstrate alternative means in Articles 53(4) and 55(2) is kept at ANSWERABILITY.
effect_on_claims: The accountability class of the Commission-provider relations is provisional and queued.

description: Article 98 states that the Commission shall be assisted by a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 and that Article 5 of that Regulation applies where reference is made to the paragraph; the committee composition and the examination procedure are those of the referenced Regulation, not retrieved.
treatment: Recorded as a type-level position referenced by the instrument with norm type AMBIGUOUS; no instance created; the examination procedure is not analysed.
effect_on_claims: Claims on the committee powers over implementing acts (Articles 37, 41, 50, 56, 58, 60, 68, 72, 92, 101) are undetermined and restricted to the cross-references.

description: Article 99 states that operators and notified bodies are subject to administrative fines but does not name the party imposing them; Article 99(9) states that, depending on the legal system, fines may be imposed by competent national courts or by other bodies.
treatment: The imposing party is recorded as a type-level position derived from paragraph 9.
effect_on_claims: Whether market surveillance authorities, which trigger fines in Articles 80 and 99, are the imposing bodies is not settled.

description: The Commission reports on the delegation and notifies delegated acts to the European Parliament and the Council, which may object or revoke; no explicit duty to explain or justify the exercise of the power is stated.
treatment: Reporting relation classified ANSWERABILITY with sufficiency indeterminate; the assessment and consequence capacities are recorded in the delegation relation.
effect_on_claims: Whether the arrangement is an accountability relation is not asserted.

description: Article 111(1) states that AI systems which are components of large-scale IT systems shall be brought into compliance by 31 December 2030 without naming the party bound.
treatment: No assignment is coded; the statement is recorded without derived records and the Annex X acts are recorded as external references.
effect_on_claims: The transitional compliance duty for Annex X systems cannot be attributed to a position from the text.

description: The data dictionary requires property_family (F1-F5) but the mapping of dimensions to families is in ON section 6.1, which is outside the allow-list.
treatment: property_family left blank for every property; recorded in the deviation log.
effect_on_claims: No family-level aggregation is possible.

description: The mapping of RGAM-DR-17 accountability sufficiency vocabulary to relation types is not stated: accountability_class ANSWERABILITY and ACCOUNTABILITY were attached to relations whose relation_type is accountability, information_reporting or review_adjudication depending on the stated relation.
treatment: accountability_class is recorded independently of relation_type; the single accountability relation objects are those with relation_type accountability.
effect_on_claims: Classification is provisional.
